requirement.name: Pre-departure documentation photographs
requirement.requirement_statement: Photographs must be sent to the site manager before departure and before the site is cleared.

source.excerpt: Vor Abfahrt und bevor die Baustelle beräumt wird müssen Fotos an den Bauleiter gesendet werden.

requirement.evidence_question: Are usable, relevant photographs present, and is there separate evidence that the required set was sent before departure/site clearance?
requirement.expected_capture: Photographs before departure/site clearance; separate transmission/timing evidence remains required.
visual_limits: A usable photograph is not proof of dispatch, recipient acknowledgment, complete coverage or timely capture.
The work order does not define an exact accepted photo count or a detailed shot list.

fallback: Keep the same P-07 requirement and source IDs; if a quality threshold disagrees with visual review, retain the metrics, record the disagreement and route both candidates to human review without retuning thresholds after the outcome.
